en.topic_title: Explainer: Hong Kong’s national security crackdown – month 75
en.topic_summary:
In September, Hong Kong saw the sentencing of three Tiananmen vigil activists, another conviction for prominent activist Joshua Wong, and the conviction of two young men with autism.



Elizabeth Tang (second from left), the mother of Chow Hang-tung (middle), and Lau Ka-yee (first from right) outside court on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
